Arise Vibe

Condominium in Si Sunthon
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleArise Vibe

Developer renders and construction-progress aerial photos from the official Ornsirin Group project page. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Arise Vibe is a condominium in Si Sunthon, Thalang, and the first Phuket project from Ornsirin Group, a Chiang Mai developer with more than 30 completed projects in northern Thailand. Listings show studio, one and two bedroom units.

Foreign buyers can hold units as freehold within the 49% foreign quota that applies to Thai condominiums. Completion is quoted as Q1 2027 by one source and late 2026 by another, so confirm the handover date with us before you commit.

The starting price shown is the lowest advertised figure. Ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list and available units.

Arise Vibe: key facts

  • Arise Vibe is a condominium in Si Sunthon, Phuket, developed by Ornsirin Group.
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 34–71.41 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Nov 2026.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿2,870,000.
